resources.string: Use a phone on the same Wi-Fi as a remote and keyboard for this launcher.
Arrows, OK, Back, Home and typing on Home, Movies, TV Shows, Search and these settings. Other apps keep using the TV remote.
Add the title on the TV, or any you search for, to My list.
Each phone pairs once with a code shown here, and can be forgotten on its own.
Phones on your Wi-Fi only, over an encrypted link. No account, and nothing leaves your home.
While it is on, Home shows a phone icon by Settings. Off means the TV doesn’t listen at all.
QR code that opens the phone remote on a phone
Scan the code with the phone’s camera
If the phone says the connection isn’t private, tap Advanced (Show Details on iPhone), then continue
Name the phone and tap Pair
No camera? Type the address, then the code
Other apps are using ports %1$d to %2$d, so phones can’t reach the TV. Turn Phone remote off and on again, or restart the TV.
The TV couldn’t make its certificate. Turn Phone remote off and on again; if it stays, restart the TV.
It stops working as a remote straight away. To use it again, pair it with the code.
Every phone stops working as a remote. The TV also makes a new code and a new certificate, so phones show the browser’s warning again when they pair.
Phones already paired keep working. The old code and QR no longer pair a phone.
Each phone warns once that the connection isn’t private: the TV makes its own certificate. Keep the TV’s address fixed in your router, or phones warn again.
